hero.title: Sculpted Hair. Couture Confidence.
hero.subtitle: Welcome to Bremen's leading hair transformation atelier. We custom craft volume, length, and dimensional shading using only double-drawn Echthaar.

brand.title: Uncompromising Quality. Tailored For You.
brand.p1: Extensions Bremen was established with a singular vision: to dismantle the average salon model and deliver the elite, meticulous standards of international high-fashion flagship houses. We treat extensions not as an accessory, but as an art form.
brand.p2: Each installation is structured around your natural hair density, texture, and facial proportions. By mapping and fusing individual micro-strands in bespoke tone transitions, we deliver weightless volume and movement that feels completely authentic.

services.title: Menu & Pricing
services.desc: Discover our curated suite of extension technologies, molecular hair therapies, and custom cut & styling integrations.
services.stylingDesc: Precision blending cuts, tones, and waves
services.details: *Includes premium European Remy double-drawn hair, custom professional blending cuts, deep scalp hydration treatment, and signature blow-wave style.

gallery.title: Transformations
gallery.desc: Browse through our portfolio of custom client extensions. Click on any model card to inspect the interactive Before & After slider.
gallery.footerText: Every transformation starts with a custom diagnostic consultation. We custom-blend multiple shades of premium hair to create natural depth.

configurator.title: Bespoke Extensions
configurator.desc: Create your personalized set. Configure color, lengths, texture, and attachment method to formulate a signature recipe tailored to your unique hair profile.
configurator.maintNote: *Includes premium European Remy double-drawn hair, custom professional blending cuts, deep scalp hydration treatment, and signature blow-wave style.

consultation.title: Virtual Consultation
consultation.desc: Answer a few quick questions about your natural hair type, lifestyle, and beauty ambitions to obtain a personalized extension prescription.
consultation.q1: 1. What is your current hair length?
consultation.q1Desc: This helps us calculate the length transition and volume requirements.
consultation.q2Desc: Ensures we match the right extension type to not strain your natural roots.
consultation.q3: 3. What is your primary hair goal?
consultation.q3Desc: Define the style transformation you want to achieve.
consultation.q4Desc: Determines attachment durability and maintenance schedule.
consultation.q5Desc: (Optional) Upload a clear photo of your hair in natural lighting so our specialists can verify color match mapping ahead of time.
